method: All link pairs with intersecting world AABBs plus MuJoCo hull contacts including parent pairs, exact source part Boolean manifold; volumes <=0.01mm3 suppressed as numerical tolerance. Fixed-base servo cases and eye carriers are also checked against every same-base part; these contacts cannot exert forces on one rigid MuJoCo body. Fixed shell-shell assembly is covered by mechanical audit. Intersections require fit-vs-collision interpretation, not automatic removal.
